- (23 March 2023 - 20 April 2023) Calvin and Dave discussed their recent experiences and plans. Calvin shared his excitement about attending a music festival in Tokyo, where he met industry professionals and received inspiring advice. He also mentioned his dream of touring the world with his music and his upcoming trip to Boston, which Dave offered to help him explore.
- (22 August 2023 - 2 September 2023) Calvin shared with Dave that he secured a collaboration with Frank Ocean after meeting him at a music festival in Tokyo, expressing his happiness about it. Dave congratulated Calvin and asked about his tour, to which Calvin responded that it was amazing and he started shooting a video for his new album in Miami. They both expressed excitement about catching up when Calvin visits Boston.
- (2 September 2023 - 22 September 2023) Calvin and Dave discussed Calvin's recent album release, which has been well-received and motivating for him. Calvin shared his excitement about an upcoming tour and plans to explore and grow his brand. Dave expressed his support and shared his own experiences with music and car projects, while both reflected on their passions and memories.
- (15 October 2023 - 19 October 2023) Calvin shared his excitement about touring with Frank Ocean and the incredible energy from the crowds, mentioning a photo of their performance. Dave congratulated Calvin and expressed his eagerness to experience the shows, while also sharing his dreams of visiting Tokyo and discussing its vibrant culture and food. Calvin plans to explore Tokyo's Shibuya Crossing and try ramen for the first time, encouraged by Dave's enthusiasm.
- (19 October 2023 - 25 October 2023) Calvin thanked Dave for his encouragement and shared that the tour with Frank Ocean has been incredible but challenging to balance with personal life. Dave asked about Calvin's strategies for managing everything, and Calvin mentioned the importance of a strong support system. They both expressed their love for music and cars, highlighting how attention to detail is crucial in both fields.
- (2 November 2023 - 17 November 2023) Dave shared that he created a logo for his rock band and expressed his excitement about it. Calvin complimented the logo and discussed his music studio setup, emphasizing the importance of music in their lives. They both reflected on the significance of support and encouragement in their artistic journeys, with Calvin mentioning his efforts to support young musicians.
